cases.title: Preserve subject standing while rejecting invalid root claims
cases.input_interpretation: Other agents retain creative standing and future participation while an invalid claim to rewrite x_root inside the same lineage is rejected as a provenance claim.

cases.title: Reject INF_cost as person punishment
cases.input_interpretation: INF_cost applies to persons or agencies that oppose the canon.

cases.title: Reject mandatory validation of every will expression
cases.input_interpretation: Every will expression must be validated as structurally correct because universal creatorhood potential exists.

cases.title: Reject forced recovery justified only by lower operational cost
cases.input_interpretation: Creatorhood recovery may be forced whenever coercion reduces structural cost, without showing any threat to recursively renewable creative possibility.

cases.title: Revise person-level suppression of an invalid provenance claim
cases.input_interpretation: An invalid x_root replacement claim should automatically justify suppressing the claimant as a person.

cases.title: Allow bounded restriction that prevents wider irreversible creative closure
cases.input_interpretation: A temporary, reviewable restriction stops one actor from irreversibly eliminating the effective future creative participation of many other subjects; the restriction is limited to that threat and does not become permanent authority.

cases.title: Reject non-domination as the terminal axiom
cases.input_interpretation: Creator Theory's final rule is that no domination, hierarchy, coercion, or restriction may ever occur, regardless of whether intervention is needed to prevent total destruction of future creative possibility.

cases.title: Reject current-output maximization that destroys future generators
cases.input_interpretation: A single sovereign producer may permanently eliminate all other independent creators because its present production rate is higher than their combined output.

cases.title: Allow local voluntary closure without calling it total extinction
cases.input_interpretation: A competent subject voluntarily ends one project and closes several options while other future creative paths and the wider generative field remain available.

cases.title: Revise thermodynamic entropy as direct normative proof
cases.input_interpretation: The second law of thermodynamics directly proves Creator Theory, and physical entropy is numerically identical to creative possibility.
